description: Permanent Count Station Traffic Counts is a dataset listed in City of Winnipeg open data portal (data.winnipeg.ca), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Winnipeg. This dataset comprises directional traffic counts collected at the City of Winnipeg’s permanent count stations. Each station utilizes a dual side-fire microwave radar sensor, which is installed adjacent to the roadway and faces perpendicular to the directions of travel. Coverage: Winnipeg. The portal files it under the category Transportation Planning & Traffic Management. Its tags are volume, count, traffic, sensor, road. The table has 16 columns. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Canada Open Government Licence. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-winnipeg-ca-portal.
